1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 12 m de altura, de tronco ramoso de corteza oscura, hojas grandes, alternas, oblongo elípticas, flores de color verde amarillo, solitarias, de olor fuerte, fruto casi redondo, de color verde amarillo o blanco azulado, con pulpa blanca, aromática y dulce, y semillas negras y duras; de su corteza se pueden obtener cuerdas de buena calidad. Annonaceae Annona squamosa.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 12 m, with a branched trunk and dark bark, large alternate elliptical leaves, solitary yellow-green flowers with strong odor, almost spherical fruit in shades of green-yellow or blue-white, with white aromatic pulp and black hard seeds; from its bark, high-quality cords can be obtained. Annonaceae Annona squamosa.

2.consolidated_definition: Fruto del anón, redondo o acorazonado, de cáscara entre negra y parda o verde con escamas regulares convexas, y de pulpa carnosa, blanca y muy dulce, con pepitas negras y duras.
2.en_consolidated_definition: Fruit of the annona, round or heart-shaped, with a skin that is between black and brown or green with regular, convex scales, and a fleshy pulp that is white and very sweet, containing hard, black seeds.
